name: Resolve a message
description: Resolve a unique Graph message ID from email_message_id (internetMessageId) or email_local_id (NetworkMessageId)

user.description: The identifier or the principal name of the user

email_message_id.description: The email message identifier mapped from email.message_id (Graph internetMessageId / Internet Message-ID RFC 5322)

email_local_id.description: The local email identifier mapped from email.local_id (Graph NetworkMessageId)

top.description: Maximum number of candidate messages to fetch before selecting one

most_recent.description: When true, sort candidates by receivedDateTime descending before applying item_index

item_index.description: Index of the candidate to select (0-based)
